name: Price Roll
summary: Pricing cards whose prices roll like counter drums when you switch between monthly and yearly
about: A pricing section with three plans in PKR. Switching the billing period stretches a pill across the switch, dips the cards and rolls every price digit like the drums of a counter, then strikes through the old price and shows the yearly saving. Choosing a plan turns its button into a progress pill, ticks, throws confetti and keeps that plan as your current one.
how: Press Monthly or Yearly: the pill stretches across, the cards dip and each price digit rolls to the new amount.
On yearly, the old monthly price is struck through and the yearly total and saving slide in.
Press Choose on a plan: the button presses, shrinks into a progress pill, ticks and throws confetti.
The chosen plan keeps a Your plan tag and a Current plan button; the others now say Switch to.
On phones the cards become a swipe row with the featured plan in the middle and dots below.
